loop.sequencing_note: T0 first. Then T1 and T2 on day 1 (T2 starts the 7-day RUM clock). Lane B (T5-T9) serially from day 1; Lane D (T15, T12, T14, T13, T16) fills WIP slack under WIP <= 3. T3 and T4 after T1 releases. T10 through the sprint. T11 only after its gates. T17 last.
loop.max_iterations_reason: 18 tasks x (execute + verify) is 36 iterations before any retry; tasks carry 3-5 attempts. 72 leaves room for retries without escalating on arithmetic; the charter D6 per-goal cap of 12 applies per SI goal, not to this 18-task plan.

close.requires: every task verified, or explicitly waived by Adam with a reason. Sprint 10 pre-authorises no drops: waiving any task requires a charter update.
close.definition_of_done: Every Sprint 10 item is Done on the board with AC-by-AC evidence, or In Progress/In Review with its PR under review, or dropped by a written charter update. HARD GATE (close form): no Sprint 10 item sits in To Do.
close.handoff: python3 scripts/harness/sprint10_hard_gate.py --json, plus the controller's evidence log
